description: This PHP test class `UniqueLangStringTest` verifies the uniqueness of language strings and unit IDs in the `I18NLangString` entity within the OrangeHRM system, ensuring data integrity in localization features.

classes.name: UniqueLangStringTest
classes.description: Test class for ensuring the uniqueness of language string values and unit IDs within the locale database, part of the localization integrity tests.

methods.name: testUniqueValue
methods.description: Tests that all language string values are unique, throwing an exception if duplicates are found.

methods.name: testUniqueUnitId
methods.description: Tests that all language string unit IDs are unique, with allowances for specific exempted IDs.
